bullets.text: Southern Railway awaits RDSO clearance to fix the train-platform gap at Adambakkam station, and the constituency team should monitor passenger safety updates.

LiveX launched NVIDIA-powered AI hosts to provide multilingual guidance in public venues, and the portfolio team should review potential public sector applications.

stories.title: Train-platform gap yet to be rectified at Adambakkam
takeaways: Southern Railway awaits RDSO clearance to fix platform gaps at Adambakkam station.
Commuter safety concerns persist until the railway platform modifications are completed.

stories.title: Avadi, Tambaram police destroy over 1.7 tonnes of ganja
takeaways: Avadi and Tambaram City Police destroyed over 1.7 tonnes of seized ganja and narcotics.
